chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from some of our companions, from one of them, regarding the casting of the pebbles (at the Jamarat).
That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) cast the pebbles while riding his mount.

key_terms.رَمْيِ الْجِمَارِ: Casting of pebbles at the Jamarat pillars during Hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to throw the pebbles at the Jamarat while riding a camel during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani’s *al-Istibsar* establishes the permissibility of casting the ritual pebbles (ramy al-jimar) while mounted, grounding the ruling in the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). It highlights the flexibility in Hajj rituals, allowing pilgrims to maintain ease and stability during the stoning of the Jamarat, a practice particularly relevant for the elderly or those with physical limitations.
